coverage_gaps.description: The two language cases capture the Installed tab rather than the Available tab, leaving visible language selection and filtered result presentation outside this batch's image coverage.
coverage_gaps.evidence: Both inspected PNGs underline Installed and display the same seven installed source rows. The sidecars retain source_filter=0 while source_language changes from all to en and available_count changes from 124 to 1. Neither PNG displays language controls or available-source result rows.
coverage_gaps.recommendation: In future evidence, open the Available tab while preserving the requested All or English language state, then capture the selected language control, filtered rows or empty state, and any applicable paging. No product defect is asserted from this coverage gap.

limitations: Only the eight candidate PNGs listed by supplemental-15.input.json were opened, each individually through tools.view_image. No independent reference PNG was supplied or loaded for this supplemental batch.

Criteria were read from phase3-reference-scope.json, the relevant scope and prototype-support text, docs/DESIGN_HANDOFF.md, and static HANDOFF.md/Main.dc.html/pw-browse.dc.html declarations. The prototype was not executed.

Existing case sidecars, their salient route/modal/sort/direction/language state, relevant checks, intentional differences, and evidence identities were read. Their recorded checks were not re-executed; hash agreement authenticates the reviewed files but does not independently verify implementation behavior.

The six sort images establish visible selected controls, direction presentation, complete filter controls, and overlay layout. They do not independently prove real SQL ordering, persistence, filter transitions, outside dismissal, touch target behavior, or page navigation.

Visible language selection, available-language result rows, language-specific empty states, and available-source paging are not covered by the two source-language screenshots because Installed remains active. This is recorded as coverage gap P3R1-SUP15-C1 rather than a product suggestion.
Sample records, counts, titles, covers, progress, and clock values are not treated as required reference data. Demo badges are not used to infer actual database unread counts.

These static desktop captures do not qualify physical Kindle wake behavior, e-ink waveforms, hardware controls, or a 512 MiB memory envelope. No local application, build, test, smoke test, or runtime probe was run.
This result applies only to supplemental-15 and does not establish a clean complete review round.
